I have farmed maize in Iringa for over forty years, and I went to primary school so I can read the bags at the agro-dealer. This 0.55 hectare plot is rented, so I will not put my manure here, but I will buy one bag of fertilizer because my neighbor had a good crop with it last season. I will plant improved seed too — I saw it work on my brother's plot — and we will weed by hand since there is no water for irrigation and I do not use chemicals on maize. My family will work about 42 days on this plot, and I will hire six days of labor when the ridging is heavy.
